concept.title: Advice about money, debt and benefits
concept.shortdesc: As someone struggling with money, I need free independent advice on debt and benefits, so that I can get what I am owed and deal with what I owe.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-026). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: people on low incomes, people in debt.
Situation: Often urgent (arrears, sanctions) and stressful.
A good result: Free, impartial advice services with how to access them, including phone and drop-in.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

section.title: How the draft did on this need
section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
